picks.editorial_note: A combined $1.1B commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments to date, positioning Georgia as a national AI research and economic-development hub.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium of 15 universities across 10 states pooling high-performance computing resources signals a major federal push toward regional AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's DOE Genesis Mission award applies AI-driven autonomous discovery to catalysis research, a concrete step toward AI systems that design and run their own scientific experiments.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project aims to build fully self-driving laboratories where AI agents and robots autonomously run photon-science experiments, a notable step toward automated scientific discovery.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Phase II DOE funding for Berkeley Lab's MOAT-Core project shows sustained federal commitment to applying AI to particle accelerator design and operation, with implications for energy and physics research.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new Genesis Mission awards extend AI-driven discovery into microelectronics and quantum information science, broadening the federal AI-for-science portfolio across national labs.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, expands shared AI computing infrastructure beyond a single institution.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: CMU's Ataraxos system beating top human players at Stratego, published in Nature, is a genuine research advance in AI decision-making under hidden information.
picks.title: CMU Researchers Develop AI That Tackles Hidden Information in Stratego

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5M, three-year commitment to Georgia Tech broadens access to AI tools and compute for scientific discovery, reflecting continued industry investment in academic AI research capacity.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: NASA's SSPICY mission demonstrates autonomous, computer-vision-based satellite inspection with minimal ground control, a real-world application of AI navigation in space operations.
picks.title: NASA’s SSPICY Mission to Demonstrate In-Space Inspection Technologies - NASA
